title: Seed project templates for dashboard exploration and inline education
creator: Sasha Kim
description:
Problem: New customers open the Redwood Console and face an empty dashboard canvas with no immediate context. They struggle to discover rollout pipelines, per-route cost views, and the console’s rollout controls. Goal: Ship a set of 3 opinionated seed project templates + lightweight inline education (tooltips + contextual guides) that let users get first insights within 2 minutes without reading docs. The templates should be scaffolded sample projects that populate dashboard widgets, rollout rules, and cost breakdowns using canned demo data and safe demo traffic.

Scope: Design templates for (1) Real-time Chat Feature (hosted inference), (2) Batch Embeddings + Similarity Search (low-cost pipeline), (3) Canary Rollout for Model Variant with cost vs latency view. Each template includes: onboarding checklist, pre-filled dashboard widgets, pre-configured rollout policy, and inline tooltip tour that highlights 6 primary console touchpoints (model selector, route cost card, SLO panel, rollout toggle, tracing link, and export link). Deliverables: Figma designs, clickable prototype, tooltip copybook, analytics event map, and final handoff tokens to engineering.

Success metrics: 30% reduction in time-to-first-dashboard-insight, 20% lift in users creating their first rollout within 7 days, and improved NPS for new accounts in the first 14 days.
acceptance_criteria: Three seed templates shipped to the Console templates gallery with unique thumbnails and short descriptions
Clickable prototype with full tooltip tour for each template validated in usability sessions (n>=8) and updated with feedback
Tooltip/copy approved by legal & content and implemented as copybook entries in i18n-ready format
Design tokens and layout spec delivered (grid, spacing, card states) and matched by engineering mock endpoints
Event map documenting analytics for: template_impression, template_apply, tour_started, tour_completed, rollout_created, cost_card_viewed
Production QA checklist with screenshots and edge-case behaviors (empty-cost-data, scaled routes, disabled rollouts)
comments: 2025-11-18 Sasha Kim: Kickoff — scoped three templates, prototype fidelity to be mid-fi. Initial copy draft attached to Figma. Asked Eng for confirm on demo traffic sandbox API.

2026-01-08 Priya Desai: Design review — simplified the tour to 6 steps after early tree-testing; replaced modals with inline callouts to reduce cognitive load. Uploaded new screen flows.

2026-01-22 James Park: Research interim — 5/6 participants completed the tour and understood where to find cost/latency trade-offs; one participant expected an 'explain cost' link. Added as a microcopy task.

2026-02-04 Evan Chen: ENG review — confirmed feasibility of pre-populating dashboard widgets via template API and recommended a lightweight schema change (template.manifest v1). Engineering to add feature flag for rollout of templates.
2026-02-18 Leah Ortiz: Analytics — event map reviewed; asked to add user_id hash and session_id to template_apply event, and to emit 'tour_skipped' metric. Updated analytics doc.
2026-02-28 Ana Gomez: Legal signoff — tooltip copy cleared for public demos; flagged one sentence referencing 'guaranteed latency' must be removed. Copybook updated.

2026-03-05 Usability: Final test — 8 participants (mix of SE/ML Engs) ran through templates; average time-to-first-insight = 1m42s. Two small accessibility issues found: color contrast on cost sparklines and missing aria-label on 'apply template' button. Filed follow-ups for engineering.
2026-03-10 Priya Desai: Ready for engineering handoff — final Figma link and prototype published; delivery notes and acceptance criteria attached. Scheduled handoff meeting with ENG for 2026-03-12.
next_steps: Engineering handoff meeting (2026-03-12). Engineering to implement template.manifest v1 and feature-flag templates. Design to provide localized copy and accessibility fixes by 2026-03-18. Schedule A/B test for default onboarding vs templates during April rollout.
notes_for_engineering: Use template.manifest v1 to seed: dashboard.widgets, rollout.policy, demo_traffic.safemode. Tooltips should be implemented as accessible callouts with skip link. Emit analytics events per the event map. Include experiment flag 'templates_init_experiment'.
ux_considerations: Prefer inline microcopy and contextual affordances over full-screen wizards. Provide immediate clear path to 'remove sample data' and to convert demo resources into real resources. For cost cards use delta vs baseline and a concise explainer tooltip.
testing_instructions: QA should validate template apply/unapply, tooltip keyboard navigation, screen-reader announcements for tour step changes, and cost rendering when no real data exists.
